artworks.title: Interior of a Peasant House with Two Women
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Cornelis Bega
artworks.medium: etching, roulette, and mezzotint with some burnishing printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18 × 16.7 cm (7 1/16 × 6 9/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene. The drawing shows a rustic and humble room with a wooden floor and a diagonal beamed ceiling. The light comes through a leaded glass window on the left, illuminating the cluttered interior. To the left, there is a bed or sleeping area with cloths and a wooden table. In the foreground, a wicker basket and a pot with its lid ajar are seen on the floor. A shelf on the wall near the ceiling is filled with candles and fabric. The drawing is done in shades of brown, giving it an old-world, warm appearance.

artworks.title: Woman Seated on a Mule
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Nicolaes Pietersz Berchem
artworks.medium: chalk manner and roulette printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 15 × 23 cm (5 7/8 × 9 1/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with figures and animals in a landscape. A man is on a horse or donkey surrounded by grazing cows and goats near water. Another man on a raft is guiding cows across the water. In the background, there are cliffs with greenery on top and a castle-like structure on the cliffs. The image is in a monochromatic color palette of shades of gray with soft brushstrokes and a sky with wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.medium: etching, mezzotint, and roulette printed from two plates in shades of brown
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.5 × 17 cm (6 7/8 × 6 11/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image features a woman holding a child in a seated position. The woman has a serene expression, gentle facial features, wavy hair, and draped clothing. She is holding her hands in a praying posture. The child has curly hair and a relaxed expression. Both figures are enclosed in a circular floral frame with roses and leaves. The background has a smooth gradient, enhancing the focus on the subjects and floral garland.

artworks.title: Directors of the Orphan Asylum of Haarlem
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Jan de Bray
artworks.medium: etching and roulette with burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22.5 × 29.6 cm (8 7/8 × 11 5/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts seven men gathered around a table. Six men are seated and one man is standing behind them. The men have long hair, wear large brimmed hats, have prominent noses and mustaches, and wear period attire, possibly from the 17th century. Several men hold objects like a pen or paper, and there is a small cup on the table. The table is covered with a richly patterned cloth. The background is plain, highlighting the group of men as the central focus.

artworks.title: Drunken Peasant at an Inn
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Adriaen Brouwer
artworks.medium: etching, mezzotint, and roulette with burnishing printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 19.4 × 15.6 cm (7 5/8 × 6 1/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image displays a man sitting on a wooden bench or stool with his legs bent and extended forward against a rustic wooden wall. He has a scruffy beard and short hair, wearing a wide-brimmed hat tilted to one side, and simple, loose-fitting clothing. He appears to have a jug or container attached to his belt or held in his lap. In the background, two other men sit at a table on a long bench, facing away from the viewer. One of the men raises a glass or mug in the air. The room features wooden walls and beams with scattered objects like hats on the floor. The setting conveys a casual, potentially rural, gathering place.

artworks.title: Flock of Goats
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Simon van der Does
artworks.medium: chalk manner and aquatint printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 14.7 × 15.6 cm (5 13/16 × 6 1/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a ground level view of an ancient ruin with a prominent arch on the left side, partially covered in vegetation. Through the arch, trees are visible in the distance. The scene includes a shepherd leading a flock of sheep, and a small tree on the right. The artwork features delicate and precise brushstrokes with a color palette dominated by muted tones of grays and browns.

artworks.title: Young Girl at the Keyboard
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Jan de Bray (formerly Gerrit Dou)
artworks.medium: chalk manner with roulette printed from two plates in gray and red-orange ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.6 × 14.6 cm (6 15/16 × 5 3/4 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman seated at a keyboard instrument. She is facing slightly to the left but looks directly at the viewer with her head turned over her shoulder. She has delicate facial features, slightly parted lips, and eyes gazing intently forward. Her hair is gathered in a decorative headpiece or ribbon and tied back, with wisps of hair framing her face. She wears a long-sleeved garment with puffed shoulders and vertical stripes, with a lighter shawl draped over it. She holds open sheet music in her hands. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed line work in the drawing.

artworks.title: Sheepcote
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Karel Dujardin
artworks.medium: chalk manner and aquatint printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 12 × 17.3 cm (4 3/4 × 6 13/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with sheep resting beside a small, thatched-roof shelter. The perspective is at ground level, offering a close view of the animals. In the background, a row of trees obscures the horizon with a lush canopy of leaves. The shelter shows signs of aging with visible straw and wood texture. The style features fine brushstrokes, capturing details of the sheep's wool and tree bark. The color palette is mostly grayscale, giving the scene a classic feel. The composition is balanced, with the sheep anchoring the image against the backdrop of foliage.

artworks.title: Town Crier
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Cornelis Dusart
artworks.medium: chalk manner, etching, and roulette with burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 20 × 15.4 cm (7 7/8 × 6 1/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly figure in a park-like setting. The central focus is on the elderly figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat and loose-fitting clothes, carrying a small drum and a stick. The figure is walking along a path under a large tree with dense foliage. In the background, there are vague architectural shapes that could be interpreted as rooftops or tents. A couple is engaged in conversation on the left, while another figure is approaching the elderly individual on the right. The scene conveys casual outdoor interaction with gentle lines and shading, creating depth and detail.

artworks.title: Salomon de Bray (formerly Jan van Goyen)
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Jan de Bray (formerly Sir Anthony van Dyck)
artworks.medium: chalk manner with some roulette printed from two plates in gray and red-orange ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 15.6 × 14 cm (6 1/8 × 5 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a side profile view from the shoulders up. The man has a nose, mustache, beard or goatee, and short wavy hair. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with a ribbon or band, and a cloak with an ornate collar design. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain, emphasizing the subject who seems to be a detailed sketch or drawing.

artworks.title: Horticulturist
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Gerbrand van den Eeckhout
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within platemark): 9.2 × 12.8 cm (3 5/8 × 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people examining botanical specimens indoors. The scene features five figures engaged in a study or discussion of plants. The setting is a well-furnished interior with large windows showing classical architecture and foliage outside. On the table are items related to botanical study, such as illustrated books, baskets of leaves and branches, and writing instruments. The drawing is done in a sepia tone with detailed lines depicting the subjects and setting.

artworks.title: Canal at Utrecht
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Jacob Esselens
artworks.medium: chalk manner and roulette printed in black ink on laid paper with some hand-coloring in light gray wash
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 16.8 × 27 cm (6 5/8 × 10 5/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a river or canal with boats on the water and a line of trees on the far shore. The drawing is done in soft pencil strokes with a limited color palette of grey. A person is in a small boat in the foreground, while larger boats with figures are moored at the bank. The sky has clouds and birds.

artworks.title: Village with Pond
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Allart van Everdingen
artworks.medium: chalk manner and aquatint with roulette and burnishing printed in red-brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.5 × 28 cm (6 7/8 × 11 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a view of a rustic village from an elevated perspective. The horizon is near the line where the church's spire meets the sky. The scene features fine brushstrokes and a monochrome color palette of various shades of brown. In the foreground, there are a barrel and wooden planks, with people and animals engaged in daily activities around thatched-roof cottages. In the background, there are ships with tall masts, large clouds, and trees.

artworks.title: Man at the Parapet
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Govaert Flinck
artworks.medium: chalk manner and roulette printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 25.2 × 18.6 cm (9 15/16 × 7 5/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body and part of the arms of a man seated in a three-quarter pose, slightly turned to his left while looking toward the viewer. His facial features include a soft, mustachioed expression with a gentle jawline and medium-length wavy hair cascading beneath a large hat. He is dressed in a loose garment with a broad collar and full sleeves, adorned with delicate patterns along the edges. The man holds a long, slender object in his left hand, and there is another elongated object that rests against his arm. The background is simple, with minimal lines suggesting a fabric draped behind him. The drawing is executed in fine detail with a clear focus on the subject's attire and demeanor.

artworks.title: Cattle Market
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Jan van Goyen
artworks.medium: chalk manner and roulette printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.1 × 26.4 cm (6 3/4 × 10 3/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a village setting, people, and animals. The horizon is low in the composition with distant structures visible. The detailed monochrome drawing depicts textures and depth, with a color palette of soft grays and whites. A dog is in the foreground, with people and cattle gathered between trees near a building. Trees and clouds fill the background.

artworks.title: Fish Market
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Jan van Goyen
artworks.medium: chalk manner and roulette printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.3 × 26.5 cm (6 13/16 × 10 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image displays a village market scene. Buildings and a steeple can be seen in the distance. There are several people engaging in various market activities. The brushstrokes are fine and delicate, creating a sense of depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray. In the foreground, a man is pushing a wheelbarrow with a small dog. Further back, groups of people are around market items and tents.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Solomon
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Jan de Bisschop (formerly Nicolaes de Bruyn; formerly Lucas van Leyden)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in red-brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 27.1 × 21.5 cm (10 11/16 × 8 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a regal scene. There is a central seated figure on a throne, under a decorative canopy, surrounded by other figures in different positions. The setting includes grand columns and arches, hinting at a ceremonial or official chamber. The artwork is detailed with intricate line work and shading, depicting ornate textile patterns and expressions of the figures, creating a historical or allegorical ambiance.

artworks.title: Musical Company
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Karel van Mander I
artworks.medium: roulette and etching with burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17 × 13.5 cm (6 11/16 × 5 5/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, both partially visible from head to toe. The standing figure on the left is holding a lute with both hands. They have a youthful face with curly hair, partially covered by an ornate hat adorned with feathers and ribbons. The figure is dressed in elaborate attire with puffed sleeves and frilled neckwear. The seated figure on the right also holds a lute, appearing engaged in playing it. They have a similar youthful appearance with a finely detailed face and hair styled with intricate curls, complemented by a ruffled collar. They wear a full, draped garment with multiple layers. The room is richly decorated with paneling on the walls, a carved balustrade above, and large windows that let in light. The flooring has a checker pattern, and the walls are adorned with artwork or engravings.

artworks.title: Valley with an Aged Castle
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Jan van der Meer II
artworks.medium: chalk manner and aquatint with etching and roulette printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 × 28.8 cm (7 5/16 × 11 5/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This image depicts a pastoral scene with a shepherd tending to a flock of sheep by a river. Lush trees are visible in the background along with a tall tower resembling a castle. The horizon is high in the image, with hills in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey and sepia. Birds can be seen flying in the sky.

artworks.title: Seated Dog
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Frans van Mieris
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 7.3 × 8.8 cm (2 7/8 × 3 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a small dog sitting. The dog is depicted in profile, with its head turned slightly away from the viewer. The drawing captures the texture and volume of the dog's long, wavy coat using shading and line work. The overall tone of the drawing is calm and serene, emphasizing the dog as the central subject within a minimalistic background.

artworks.title: Lying Dog
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Frans van Mieris
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 7.5 × 9.2 cm (2 15/16 × 3 5/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a small dog resting on a cushioned surface. The image captures a small dog lying down with its head resting on its paws. The texture of the dog's fur is illustrated with detail, emphasizing the curls and volume. The surrounding environment appears simple, with hints of texture above the dog's back and behind it. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette and shading to create depth and define the form of the dog.

artworks.title: Lady with Double-Headed Lute
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Caspar Netscher
artworks.medium: aquatint with etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: shee (trimmed within platemark)t: 15.7 × 12.8 cm (6 3/16 × 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person sitting in a relaxed position, facing slightly to the side. The person has curly shoulder-length hair styled back, wearing a textured garment with fur-trimmed edges. They are holding a musical instrument resembling a lute, with hands delicately placed on the strings and neck. The background is simple, featuring a large oval shape that centers the subject within the composition.

artworks.title: Woman Leaning over a Lower Door
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel, after Nicolaes Maes (formerly Rembrandt van Rijn)
artworks.medium: etching and roulette printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 15.6 × 14.7 cm (6 1/8 × 5 13/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a person's body from behind. The individual is leaning slightly forward, with their head protruding through an open doorway, seemingly looking outside. Their facial features are not visible, but their head is covered with a cap or a scarf, indicating short hair or hair tied back. They wear an outer garment with lengthy, loose sleeves. The person is framed by the doorway, with parts of the door visible on both sides. No jewelry or objects are visible. Through the doorway, foliage is visible, suggesting an outdoor setting with filtered light. The predominant colors are sepia tones, creating a vintage ambiance.

artworks.title: Boy Leaning over a Lower Door
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel, after Samuel van Hoogstraten (formerly Rembrandt van Rijn)
artworks.medium: etching and roulette printed in brown ink on laid paper and hand-colored with red chalk
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 23.8 × 18.7 cm (9 3/8 × 7 3/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning forward through an arched stone or brick opening. The subject is positioned with their arms resting on a ledge, hands clasped, looking directly at the viewer. They have a youthful face with soft features, light-colored eyes, and shoulder-length hair that peeks from under a wide-brimmed hat. They are wearing a dark-colored garment, possibly a jacket, with a long, patterned scarf or accessory draped around the neck. The background is dark, with arched stone or brickwork framing the upper part of the image, drawing focus to the subject inside the enclosure.
